query:
SELECT p.id, p.name, 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saleItems si WHERE si.productId = p.id) as vendas,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchaseItems pi WHERE pi.productId = p.id) as compras,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM productMovements pm WHERE pm.productId = p.id) as movimentos
FROM products p 
WHERE p.id IN (5280001, 5280002, 5310001, 5310002, 5310003, 4950001, 4950002, 4950003, 4950004, 2070009);
